children: Overview
Switzerland private markets manager's H1 revenue fell 7% and missed analyst expectations
H1 management income rose 6%, while performance income dropped 39% yr/yr
Company announced executive team rotations, with new Co-CEOs effective January 2027
Outlook
Partners Group expects gross new client demand of USD 26-32 bln for full-year 2026
Company sees 2026 performance income at around 20-25% of total revenues
Partners Group maintains mid- to long-term guidance for performance income at 25-40% of revenues
Result Drivers
CLIENT DEMAND - Co said sustained demand for bespoke client solutions and traditional programs contributed to higher management income
ACCELERATED EXITS - Co said performance income fell due to several sizable H2 2025 exits that were accelerated to capture market momentum
LOWER PERSONNEL EXPENSES - Co said operating costs decreased mainly due to lower variable performance fee-related personnel expenses and AI-driven productivity gains
